purpose: Determine whether a separately reviewed stable-reference route could use the same two exact ASF RTC products after the event-only staged rasters stopped at control selection.

exact_product_header_geometry.current_staged_display_scope: Only common-valid cells inside AOI-SOURCE union AOI-UPPER-CORRIDOR; no reference pixels outside that union.

projected_geometry_screen.method: Shapely 2.1.2 polygon area in EPSG:32645: approved AOI-OVERVIEW difference from union of AOI-SOURCE and AOI-UPPER-CORRIDOR buffered by each stated distance, then intersection with both exact product header rectangles. No raster or external vector was opened.

assessment: The exact ASF source-product headers leave broad geometric room outside the event-only staging, and a separate mapped event/analysis vector family exists. Neither fact supplies 30 verified stable control windows. A new route would require independent source/rights/integrity review for any UNOSAT vectors; an explicit, fixed non-change control rule that respects the analyzed-area limit and event uncertainty; separately authorized reads of the original ASF RTC product pixels outside the old stage; generated-data and installed-runtime tests; and a fresh one-attempt, CI-gated execution contract. The prior stopped route, full-area defer statuses, and M4 scientific rules remain unchanged.
